Stop the folder map's local servers

Source: R/map_folder.R
stop_folder_map.Rd

Stops the servers map_folder() has started in this R session. Other httpuv servers, such as Shiny apps, are left alone.

Usage

stop_folder_map()

Value

Invisibly, the number of servers stopped.

Examples

stop_folder_map()
